title: GoogleSnake
description: A Minecraft Mod that adds Google Snake
body:
Snake Mod adds the classic Snake game directly into Minecraft, fully playable in-world using blocks and player movement.

How to Play

Type snake <size> [speed] in chat to generate a board anywhere in your world. The board is built around you instantly — a checkered green floor, glass walls, and a control platform you're teleported to. Move left, right, forward, or backward on the platform to steer your snake. Eat the red concrete apples to grow longer and score points. Don't hit the walls or yourself — or it's game over.

Commands

    snake <size> — Start a game with a board of the given size (4–100)
    snake <size> <speed> — Start with a custom speed (1 = slowest, 6 = fastest)
    stop — Quit your current game
    clear — Remove the board after a game ends
    help — Show command info in chat

Features

    Fully in-world snake game built from Minecraft blocks
    Checkerboard green floor, glass walls, and wool snake
    Apples spawn randomly on the board — more appear as your score increases
    Alternating cyan and light blue wool body so you can track your snake's length
    Score displayed above your hotbar throughout the game
    Game over title screen showing your final score with a firework
    Speed boost effect while playing so steering feels responsive
    Multiplayer support — multiple players can run independent games simultaneously
    Board size and speed fully customizable per game
    clear command to clean up the board when you're done

Multiplayer

Not working yet for multiple players, only one player can play at a time.

 

-This mod was for a YouTube video for my channel, FerrettMC
